comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record clamps and drills an aluminum bar.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs fine latch probing and extraction; record aligns a workpiece, tightens a screw clamp, operates a drill press, and maintains hazardous-tool clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires undamaged selective removal; record requires a through-hole near the punch mark while clamped, no unsafe proximity, and the drill retracted.
comparison.reason: Workholding and powered cutting are unrelated to connector release.
